column1: # Choose the coverage tracks to show above the gene models
# source may be any of:
#   an ENCODE accession   ENCSR124NNL for an experiment, ENCFF435JGG for one file
#   a URL                 read by byte range, so the host must allow that and allow CORS
#   a path                to a bigWig on this machine
# strand   Leave blank for an unstranded assay; otherwise use plus or minus and give both
#          files in a stranded pair the same track_id
# bin      Bases per point in the local copy; leave blank to use --browser-bin or use 0 to
#          keep the source resolution
# local    Use yes to add a family-specific copy to the site, no to read it over the
#          network, or leave blank to follow --slice-coverage
# citation, url, license_spdx are optional fields shown in the About panel. Use them for
#          local or in-house tracks without a public accession. Set url to a page that
#          describes the data, not to the bigWig. A value is shown for a group only when
#          all tracks that provide it use the same value
# The rows below are public ENCODE tissue ATAC-seq tracks read over the network
# Replace them with your own assay when one is available
# The ENCODE examples leave the optional provenance fields blank
# Separate columns with tabs; blank lines and comments are ignored
